subject: Pen test scheduling — scope addendum & blackbox slot confirmation
messages:
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acmepay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test — proposed windows and scope question

Hi Kimberly / Neha,

Thanks again for coordinating last week. We need to lock down dates for the annual external penetration test for Acme Payments. Our initial ask from risk: week of June 14 for internal (whitebox) testing and a separate external blackbox slot the week after (June 21) — vendor will need external target IPs and a short maintenance window.

A couple quick questions:
- Can Redwood accommodate a blackbox run that does not require VPN credentials (external-only)?
- Who at Redwood will be the primary contact for temporary allowlist changes and short-lived credentials?

If you can confirm the vendor and SOW, procurement will issue the PO.

Best,
Sofia Alvarez
Product Security, Acme Payments

[Attachment: Acme_PT_requirements.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@sentinelsec.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pen test engagement — scheduling request from Acme Payments

Alex —

Acme has proposed internal (whitebox) the week of June 14 and a separate blackbox external the week of June 21. Can Sentinel confirm availability for those two consecutive weeks?

Scope notes:
- whitebox: code & infra review + credentialed host scans
- blackbox: external perimeter + app-layer tests, no VPN/SSH required (target will be public IPs and FQDNs)
- deliverables: full report + executive summary + remediation verification run (within 2 weeks)

Please attach an updated SOW that includes the blackbox addendum and the timeline. Also include the IP addresses you will need to be allowlisted (we prefer a CSV).

Procurement wants the DocuSign SOW link so they can push PO.

Thanks — I'll loop in procurement once we have the SOW and allowlist.

Kimberly Park
Security Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@sentinelsec.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acmepay.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pen test engagement — scheduling request from Acme Payments

Kimberly —

We can do both weeks. Draft SOW attached — version 2 adds the blackbox slot and clarifies deliverables. We request the following to run the external (blackbox) engagement cleanly:
- A public target inventory (FQDNs and IPs) + any WAF bypass guidance (if applicable)
- Allowlist of our egress IPs (we run from three cloud regions) — see attached CSV stub.
- A contact for emergency throttling or take-down requests during the test window.

Tentative schedule:
- Jun 14–18: whitebox (onsite/remote, credentialed)
- Jun 21–25: blackbox (external)
- Report delivery: initial report within 7 business days after each engagement, final consolidated report + executive summary within 10 business days after last engagement

Attached: Sentinel_SOW_v2.pdf, network-allowlist.csv, Sentinel_Final_Report_Sample.pdf

Alex Turner
Senior Engagement Lead | SentinelSec
[Attachment: Sentinel_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 320KB); network-allowlist.csv (text/csv); Sentinel_Final_Report_Sample.pdf (application/pdf, 900KB)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Sentinel SOW + scheduling — decision request

Team — forwarding Sentinel's SOW and proposed schedule. Key decisions needed by EOD Monday so procurement can issue PO:
- Approve external blackbox the week of Jun 21 (we'll not provide VPN creds; vendor will test public IPs only)
- Approve allowlisting their egress IPs for the two-week window (CSV attached)
- Confirm who will be the emergency contact during tests (I propose Marcus for infra take-downs and Vivek for security escalations)

If we add the blackbox run, we should also require a remediation verification scan (small scope) two weeks after the final report — add to SOW if you agree.

Thanks,
Kim

Subject: Re: Fwd: Sentinel SOW + scheduling — decision request

Kim / team —

I support adding the blackbox slot with the following controls as conditions:
1) Vendor IP allowlist must be narrow and time-limited; provide CSV with CIDRs (we cannot make broad egress exceptions).
2) MFA-enforced portal for any credentialed artifact (if any credentials are necessary for whitebox).
3) We require the remediation verification run (small-scope) to be included in the SOW; acceptance criteria: documented fixes + evidence attached to remediation log template.

I've attached a remediation-log-template.xlsx we use to track vuln -> fix -> verification. Ask procurement to include PO language that ties payment to timely delivery of the initial report (we can hold final 10% until verification).

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: remediation-log-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
